text: (2) I, Shri,/Smti………………………………………………………..having been appointed Chairperson/Member of the Lokayukta do swear in the name of God/Solemnly affirm that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India as by law established and that I will duly and faithfully and to the best of my ability, knowledge and judgement perform the duties of my office without fear or favour, affection or ill-will.” Order Appendix Forms Show All Sections Previous × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)Rules YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi)15-01-2020 The Meghalaya Lokayukta Rules,2019 Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)Regulations"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)CircularsYearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)NotificationsYearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)Orders" YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)Ordinances"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng) Files(Hindi) Close × Act NameThe Meghalaya Lokayukta Act, 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014)Statutes"YearDescriptionHindi DescriptionFiles(Eng)Files(Hindi) Close
